facts.title: Strawberry Smash Cocktail
ingredients: 1 medium lemon, juiced (plus more for garnish)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a mixing glass, thoroughly muddle strawberries with the basil.
Squeeze in the juice of one lemon and a drizzle of honey.
Fill a collins glass with ice and pour your mixture into the glass. Top it off with club soda.
Mix by pouring the drink back into your mixing glass, then back into your drinking glass. Garnish with lemon round and a strawberry.

notes: Strained option: If you aren’t down with chunks of smashed strawberry floating in your drink, just pour the mixture through a strainer, into a glass filled with ice.
facts.summary: Summery cocktail made with strawberries, basil, vodka, club soda and a drizzle of honey. Cheers!
